display_long_description:
[media]

**Compass** is an open-world VR flying adventure set among otherworldly skies.
You are a scout flying ahead of a wandering Caravan, charting safe routes through unknown skies.



# RIDE THE CLOUDS
[media]
Take control of your flying vessel and travel across vast open skies filled with changing environments. Upgrade your ship to venture farther and get through dangerous routes.


# COMPLETE CHALLENGES
[media]
Leave the cockpit and use your hand grapples to swing through ruins, climb structures, and complete environmental challenges scattered across the skies.


# SCOUT THE UNKNOWN
[media]
Explore new regions, recover lost cargo, meet the people living among the clouds, and search for signs of your missing companions as you discover what lies beyond the horizon.
